content.json:
# Arc Machine Intelligence Center
*One Azure Arc machine in one place: identity, live performance, security, software changes, SQL, extensions, policy and uptime. The page opens on a Windows host with the Azure Monitor Agent; use **Machine** to switch. A machine with no Azure Monitor Agent (such as the nested SQL guest) is labelled and still shows its Arc, Defender and SQL inventory.*

parameters.name: Machine
parameters.label: Machine
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend Os = tostring(properties.osType), SqlHost = tobool(properties.detectedProperties.mssqldiscovered), MachineId = tolower(id)
| join kind=leftouter (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions' and name in~ ('AzureMonitorWindowsAgent', 'AzureMonitorLinuxAgent') and tostring(properties.provisioningState) !~ 'Failed'
    | summarize AgentExt = take_any(name) by MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/extensions/')[0]))) on MachineId
| extend HasAgent = isnotempty(AgentExt)
| extend Group = case(Os =~ 'windows' and HasAgent, 'Windows with Azure Monitor Agent', Os =~ 'windows', 'Windows without Azure Monitor Agent', Os =~ 'linux', 'Linux', 'Other')
| extend GroupOrder = case(Group startswith 'Windows with ', 1, Group == 'Linux', 2, Group startswith 'Windows without', 3, 4)
| extend SortKey = strcat(tostring(GroupOrder), iff(SqlHost == true, '0', '1'), tolower(name))
| join kind=leftouter (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
    | extend Os = tostring(properties.osType), SqlHost = tobool(properties.detectedProperties.mssqldiscovered), MachineId = tolower(id)
    | join kind=leftouter (resources
        | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions' and name in~ ('AzureMonitorWindowsAgent', 'AzureMonitorLinuxAgent') and tostring(properties.provisioningState) !~ 'Failed'
        | summarize AgentExt = take_any(name) by MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/extensions/')[0]))) on MachineId
    | extend GroupOrder = case(Os =~ 'windows' and isnotempty(AgentExt), 1, Os =~ 'linux', 2, Os =~ 'windows', 3, 4)
    | extend SortKey = strcat(tostring(GroupOrder), iff(SqlHost == true, '0', '1'), tolower(name))
    | summarize BestKey = min(SortKey)
    | project SortKey = BestKey, IsBest = true) on SortKey
| order by SortKey asc
| project value = name, label = strcat(name, ' (', iff(Os =~ 'windows', 'Windows', iff(Os =~ 'linux', 'Linux', Os)), iff(SqlHost == true, ', SQL', ''), iff(Group startswith 'Windows without', ', no Azure Monitor Agent', ''), ')'), selected = IsBest == true, group = Group

content.json:
## Machine at a glance
Arc identity first, then the newest telemetry sample. Each tile says when it was last updated.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' and tolower(name) == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1]))
| extend Status = tostring(properties.status), AgentVersion = tostring(properties.agentVersion), Changed = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange),
    Cores = toint(properties.detectedProperties.logicalCoreCount), MemGb = toreal(properties.detectedProperties.totalPhysicalMemoryInGigabytes),
    OsSku = tostring(properties.osSku), OsType = tostring(properties.osType), Role = tostring(tags['role']), Env = tostring(tags['env'])
| extend OsShort = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(OsSku, 'Windows Server ', 'Server '), ' Evaluation', ' Eval'), ' Edition', '')
| extend AgentMajor = strcat(tostring(split(AgentVersion, '.')[0]), '.', tostring(split(AgentVersion, '.')[1]))
| extend ChangedMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), Changed)
| extend ChangedText = case(ChangedMin < 120, strcat(ChangedMin, ' min ago'), ChangedMin < 2880, strcat(toint(round(ChangedMin / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(toint(round(ChangedMin / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago'))
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Label', 'Arc connection', 'Value', Status, 'Note', strcat('agent v', AgentMajor, ', since ', ChangedText), 'Order', 1),
    pack('Label', 'Operating system', 'Value', iff(OsType =~ 'windows', 'Windows', iff(OsType =~ 'linux', 'Linux', OsType)), 'Note', substring(OsShort, 0, 30), 'Order', 2),
    pack('Label', 'Compute', 'Value', strcat(Cores, ' vCPU'), 'Note', strcat(toint(round(MemGb, 0)), ' GB memory'), 'Order', 3),
    pack('Label', 'Role', 'Value', iff(isempty(Role), 'untagged', Role), 'Note', strcat('environment: ', iff(isempty(Env), 'untagged', Env)), 'Order', 4))
| mv-expand data
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = tostring(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note), Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note

content.json:
### Security: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Compliance and recommendation checks for this machine. The score is the share of assessed (healthy plus unhealthy) checks that pass; checks that do not apply are listed, not counted. This lab is intentionally un-hardened, so a low score is the honest result.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend rname = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.ResourceName)), rtype = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.ResourceType)), nid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.NativeResourceId))
| where rname == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1])) and (rtype contains 'hybridcompute' or nid contains 'hybridcompute')
| extend Status = tostring(properties.status.code), Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName)
| summarize Healthy = countif(Status == 'Healthy'), Unhealthy = countif(Status == 'Unhealthy'), High = countif(Status == 'Unhealthy' and Severity == 'High'), Medium = countif(Status == 'Unhealthy' and Severity == 'Medium'), Low = countif(Status == 'Unhealthy' and Severity == 'Low'), NotApplicable = countif(Status == 'NotApplicable')
| extend Assessed = Healthy + Unhealthy
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Label', 'Checks healthy', 'Value', iff(Assessed > 0, strcat(toint(round(100.0 * Healthy / Assessed, 0)), '%'), 'None'), 'Note', strcat(Healthy, ' of ', Assessed, ' assessed checks'), 'Order', 1),
    pack('Label', 'High severity', 'Value', tostring(High), 'Note', 'open (unhealthy) checks', 'Order', 2),
    pack('Label', 'Medium severity', 'Value', tostring(Medium), 'Note', 'open (unhealthy) checks', 'Order', 3),
    pack('Label', 'Low severity', 'Value', tostring(Low), 'Note', 'open (unhealthy) checks', 'Order', 4),
    pack('Label', 'Not applicable', 'Value', tostring(NotApplicable), 'Note', 'not counted in the score', 'Order', 5))
| mv-expand data
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = tostring(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note), Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note
content.title: Defender checks
content.noDataMessage: Defender for Cloud has no assessments for this machine. Defender for Servers is not enabled on it, or the first assessment has not run yet.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend rname = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.ResourceName)), rtype = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.ResourceType)), nid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.NativeResourceId))
| where rname == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1])) and (rtype contains 'hybridcompute' or nid contains 'hybridcompute')
| extend Status = tostring(properties.status.code), Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName)
| where Status == 'Unhealthy'
| extend SeverityRank = case(Severity == 'High', 1, Severity == 'Medium', 2, Severity == 'Low', 3, 4)
| project Recommendation, Severity, Status, Category = tostring(properties.metadata.categories[0]), Since = todatetime(properties.status.statusChangeDate), SeverityRank
| order by SeverityRank asc, Recommendation asc
| take 20
| project Recommendation, Severity, Category, Since
content.title: Open recommendations (top 20, highest severity first)
content.noDataMessage: No open recommendations for this machine. Either every assessed check is healthy, or Defender for Cloud has no assessments for it.

content.json:
### Software and configuration changes
Change Tracking and Inventory: installs, removals and modifications on this machine, per time interval. Windows reports software and services, Linux reports software and daemons.

### Software and configuration changes
**No Azure Monitor data from {Machine} in this time range, so there are no Change Tracking records.** Change Tracking needs the Azure Monitor Agent and the ChangeTracking extension; a machine without the agent (such as the nested SQL guest) records nothing. Pick a machine marked with the agent, or a longer time range.

content.json:
### SQL Server on this machine
Two different kinds of evidence. **Arc inventory** (instance, version, databases) exists only where the Arc SQL extension is installed. **Azure Monitor** can observe a real SQL workload through the Windows Application log, with no Arc SQL at all.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' and tolower(name) == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1]))
| extend Mssql = tobool(properties.detectedProperties.mssqldiscovered), Pgsql = tobool(properties.detectedProperties.pgsqldiscovered), Mysql = tobool(properties.detectedProperties.mysqldiscovered)
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Label', 'SQL Server on host', 'Value', iff(Mssql == true, 'Detected', 'Not detected'), 'Note', 'seen by the Arc agent', 'Order', 1),
    pack('Label', 'PostgreSQL on host', 'Value', iff(Pgsql == true, 'Detected', 'Not detected'), 'Note', 'seen by the Arc agent', 'Order', 2),
    pack('Label', 'MySQL on host', 'Value', iff(Mysql == true, 'Detected', 'Not detected'), 'Note', 'seen by the Arc agent', 'Order', 3))
| mv-expand data
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = tostring(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note), Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note
content.title: Database engines found by Arc
content.noDataMessage: This machine is not an Azure Arc machine in the subscriptions you can read, so nothing was detected.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| where tolower(tostring(properties.containerResourceId)) endswith strcat('/machines/', tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1])))
| extend InvMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), todatetime(properties.lastInventoryUploadTime))
| project Instance = name, Version = tostring(properties.version), Edition = tostring(properties.edition), Licence = tostring(properties.licenseType), Status = tostring(properties.status),
    Defender = tostring(properties.azureDefenderStatus),
    InventoryAge = case(InvMin < 120, strcat(InvMin, ' min ago'), InvMin < 2880, strcat(toint(round(InvMin / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(toint(round(InvMin / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago'))
| order by Instance asc
content.title: Arc-enabled SQL Server instances
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instance is registered for this machine, even if SQL Server is running on it (the tiles above show what the Arc agent saw). One appears here once the Arc SQL extension (WindowsAgent.SqlServer) is installed and the instance registers.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| where tolower(tostring(properties.containerResourceId)) endswith strcat('/machines/', tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1])))
| project InstanceId = tolower(id), Instance = name
| join kind=inner (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases'
    | extend InstanceId = tolower(tostring(substring(id, 0, indexof(tolower(id), '/databases/'))))
    | project InstanceId, Database = name, State = tostring(properties.state), SizeMB = todouble(properties.sizeMB), Recovery = tostring(properties.recoveryMode), CompatibilityLevel = toint(properties.compatibilityLevel)) on InstanceId
| project Instance, Database, State, SizeMB = round(SizeMB, 1), Recovery, CompatibilityLevel
| order by Instance asc, Database asc
content.title: Databases in those instances
content.noDataMessage: No databases to list: no Arc SQL instance is registered in scope, or its database inventory has not been indexed yet (Resource Graph can lag after a rebuild; LicenseOnly mode lists the instance only).

content.json:
### Arc management
Extensions installed on this machine and Azure Policy compliance. Extension states are live: Creating or Updating means the extension is still being applied, not that it failed.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions'
| extend Machine = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/')[8]))
| where Machine == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1]))
| project Extension = name, State = tostring(properties.provisioningState), Publisher = tostring(properties.publisher), Version = tostring(properties.typeHandlerVersion), AutoUpgrade = iff(tobool(properties.enableAutomaticUpgrade) == true, 'Yes', 'No')
| order by Extension asc
content.title: Installed extensions
content.noDataMessage: No extensions are installed on this Arc machine. Extensions such as the Azure Monitor Agent, Change Tracking and Microsoft Defender appear here once they are installed.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| extend ResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)), Compliance = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| where ResourceId contains '/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/'
| extend ResourceName = tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[8])
| where ResourceName == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1])) and Compliance in ('Compliant', 'NonCompliant', 'Conflict')
| summarize Total = count(), Compliant = countif(Compliance == 'Compliant'), NonCompliant = countif(Compliance == 'NonCompliant')
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Label', 'Policy compliance', 'Value', strcat(toint(round(100.0 * Compliant / Total, 0)), '%'), 'Note', strcat(Compliant, ' of ', Total, ' compliant'), 'Order', 1),
    pack('Label', 'Non-compliant', 'Value', tostring(NonCompliant), 'Note', 'policy evaluations failing', 'Order', 2),
    pack('Label', 'Evaluations', 'Value', tostring(Total), 'Note', 'policy checks on this machine', 'Order', 3))
| mv-expand data
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = tostring(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note), Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note
content.title: Azure Policy
content.noDataMessage: Azure Policy has no evaluation results for this machine yet. Policy states appear after the first compliance scan (up to a day after assignment).

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| extend ResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)), Compliance = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| where ResourceId contains '/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/'
| extend ResourceName = tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[8])
| where ResourceName == tolower(tostring(split('{Machine}', '/')[-1])) and Compliance in ('Compliant', 'NonCompliant', 'Conflict')
| where Compliance == 'NonCompliant'
| extend DefId = tolower(tostring(properties.policyDefinitionName)), SetId = tolower(tostring(properties.policySetDefinitionName)), RefId = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId)
| extend Policy = case(
    DefId == '6ba6d016-e7c3-4842-b8f2-4992ebc0d72d', 'SQL servers on machines should have vulnerability findings resolved',
    DefId == 'f85bf3e0-d513-442e-89c3-1784ad63382b', 'System updates should be installed on your machines (powered by Update Center)',
    DefId == '72650e9f-97bc-4b2a-ab5f-9781a9fcecbc', 'Windows machines should meet requirements of the Azure compute security baseline',
    DefId == 'bed48b13-6647-468e-aa2f-1af1d3f4dd40', 'Windows Defender Exploit Guard should be enabled on your machines',
    DefId == '5752e6d6-1206-46d8-8ab1-ecc2f71a8112', 'Windows machines should be configured to use secure communication protocols',
    DefId == '630c64f9-8b6b-4c64-b511-6544ceff6fd6', 'Authentication to Linux machines should require SSH keys',
    DefId == 'fc9b3da7-8347-4380-8e70-0a0361d8dedd', 'Linux machines should meet requirements for the Azure compute security baseline',
    DefId == 'bd876905-5b84-4f73-ab2d-2e7a7c4568d9', 'Machines should be configured to periodically check for missing system updates',
    DefId == '65503269-6a54-4553-8a28-0065a8e6d929', 'Configure Arc-enabled SQL Servers to automatically install Microsoft Defender for SQL',
    isnotempty(RefId) and not(tolower(RefId) matches regex '^[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+$'), RefId,
    strcat('Built-in policy ', substring(DefId, 0, 8)))
| extend Initiative = case(
    SetId == '1f3afdf9-d0c9-4c3d-847f-89da613e70a8', 'Microsoft cloud security benchmark',
    SetId == '179d1daa-458f-4e47-8086-2a68d0d6c38f', 'NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5',
    SetId == 'c1529623-9fc2-45bc-b84b-b14cd0b7484e', 'Defender for SQL on machines',
    isempty(SetId), 'Assigned directly',
    strcat('Initiative ', substring(SetId, 0, 8)))
| extend AssignmentName = tostring(properties.policyAssignmentName), EvaluatedAt = todatetime(properties.timestamp)
| summarize Assignments = dcount(AssignmentName), LastEvaluated = max(EvaluatedAt) by Policy, Initiative
| extend EvalMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastEvaluated)
| order by Policy asc, Initiative asc
| take 25
| project Policy, Initiative, Assignments, EvaluatedAge = case(EvalMin < 120, strcat(EvalMin, ' min ago'), EvalMin < 2880, strcat(toint(round(EvalMin / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(toint(round(EvalMin / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago'))
content.title: Non-compliant policies
content.noDataMessage: No non-compliant policies for this machine: every evaluated policy passes, or none has been evaluated yet (see the Azure Policy tile above).

content.json:
### Events and uptime
How steadily the machine reports, and which log sources are loud. Windows reads the Event log, Linux reads Syslog. Agent reporting of 100% means a heartbeat every minute. Each column is one time interval; a blank stretch means the machine was parked or silent.

### Events and uptime
**No heartbeat, Event or Syslog data from {Machine} in this time range.** It either has no Azure Monitor Agent (such as the nested SQL guest, which the Machine list marks) or it was off for the whole range, so there is nothing to chart. Pick a machine marked with the agent, or a longer time range.
